<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram id="choosing-tier" name="How to choose a tier for a workload"> <mxGraphModel dx="1906" dy="697" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="900" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="s1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3F4B57;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#232F3E;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="1️⃣ Which Regions must this run in?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="280" x="250" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s1-note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#E8F4FD;strokeColor=#147EB4;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#545B64;shadow=0;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontStyle=2;" value="Luna, Terra — us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2
Sol — us-east-1, us-east-2

Residency is not negotiable, so this comes first" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="270" x="570" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3F4B57;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#232F3E;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="2️⃣ Define the quality bar in business terms" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="280" x="250" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s2-note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#E8F4FD;strokeColor=#147EB4;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#545B64;shadow=0;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontStyle=2;" value="e.g. "no incorrect basket total"
"every high-severity ticket routed correctly"

Before looking at any model" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="270" x="570" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F0F8FF;strokeColor=#0073BB;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#232F3E;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="3️⃣ Measure Luna against the bar" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="280" x="250" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3-note" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=9;fontColor=#879596;fontStyle=2;" value="On your own labelled set" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="150" x="545" y="250" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d1" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F0F8FF;strokeColor=#0073BB;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#232F3E;shadow=1;" value="Clears the bar?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="140" x="320" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ship" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#4a7a3a;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="✅ Ship on Luna" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="150" x="100" y="362.5" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ship-note" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=9;fontColor=#4a7a3a;fontStyle=2;" value="At volume this is
where the money is" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="25" width="140" x="105" y="407.5" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#3F4B57;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#232F3E;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="4️⃣ Escalate — measure Terra, then Sol if needed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="320" x="230" y="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s5-note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#E8F4FD;strokeColor=#147EB4;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#545B64;shadow=0;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontStyle=2;" value="Enough cases that one answer is a small
fraction of the score; repeat each run" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="230" x="610" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E8;strokeColor=#E07D1A;strokeWidth=2;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#8A4B00;shadow=1;arcSize=8;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="5️⃣ Use different tiers for different steps:
cheap tier for routing, strong tier for what matters" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="340" x="220" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s6-note" parent="1" style="text;html=0;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=9;fontColor=#8A4B00;fontStyle=2;" value="The normal end state, not a compromise" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="280" x="250" y="675" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reentry" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F9F2F4;strokeColor=#C9184A;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#6B0F2A;shadow=0;arcSize=12;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" value="6️⃣ Re-run when a new model ships
